all_candidates.topic: Do viral social media posts effectively improve food safety standards?
all_candidates.news_anchor: India's food safety crackdown is intensifying, driven by viral social media posts exposing unhygienic conditions, leading to increased government inspections, reported September 2, 2026.

all_candidates.topic: Are AI-driven layoffs fundamentally altering India's job market?
all_candidates.news_anchor: Corporate layoffs in India in 2026 are primarily driven by AI adoption and automation, leading to a restructuring of traditional roles, reported September 5, 2026.

all_candidates.topic: Should all PG hostels face mandatory annual safety audits?
all_candidates.news_anchor: A Delhi building collapse on September 6, 2026, that killed seven people prompted the Delhi High Court to direct the MCD to inspect all PG hostels within a week.

all_candidates.topic: Should a national task force oversee all major exam reforms?
all_candidates.news_anchor: India's exam system faces a 'crisis of trust' after paper leaks, with a high-level task force appointed on September 8, 2026, to recommend reforms.

all_candidates.topic: Will AI agents truly replace traditional smartphone apps soon?
all_candidates.news_anchor: Paytm founder Vijay Shekhar Sharma predicted on September 7, 2026, that autonomous AI agents will replace smartphone apps by 2027.

all_candidates.topic: Should merchants pay MDR for large UPI transactions?
all_candidates.news_anchor: The Government of India recently clarified that while UPI remains free for consumers, a nominal Merchant Discount Rate (MDR) may apply to certain merchant transactions above a threshold.

all_candidates.topic: Should all fuel subsidies be transparently disclosed to consumers?
all_candidates.news_anchor: Delhi's fifth CNG hike this year, announced August 29 and reported September 3, 2026, highlighted concerns over selective pricing and hidden fuel subsidies.

all_candidates.topic: Should universities offer free re-checking for all exam results?
all_candidates.news_anchor: Gujarat Technological University (GTU) declared results for several Summer 2026 examinations on September 8, 2026, opening re-check applications until September 11.

all_candidates.topic: Is embedded AI in daily products a net positive?
all_candidates.news_anchor: InfoComm India 2026, reported on September 8, 2026, will feature live AI on the show floor, with over 10% of new products embedding AI.

all_candidates.topic: Should exam application correction windows be longer?
all_candidates.news_anchor: The CTET 2026 application correction window opened on September 7 and closes on September 10, 2026, for candidates to rectify details.

all_candidates.topic: Should government bodies simplify complex recruitment processes?
all_candidates.news_anchor: The Uttar Pradesh Education Services Selection Commission (UPESSC) started registration for the Assistant Professor recruitment exam 2026 on September 8, 2026.

all_candidates.topic: Is mandatory UPI data masking beneficial for user privacy?
all_candidates.news_anchor: NPCI requires all UPI apps and banks to mask mobile numbers, UPI IDs, and account numbers by September 4, 2026, for privacy enhancement.

all_candidates.topic: Are current corporate layoffs in electronics justified by market shifts?
all_candidates.news_anchor: Samsung India has started laying off 80-100 employees in its television and home appliance businesses due to chip price increases and falling smartphone volumes, reported September 8, 2026.

all_candidates.topic: Should India diversify IT services beyond US work visas?
all_candidates.news_anchor: Indian IT stocks lost Rs 55,000 crore on September 9, 2026, after the US suspended Cognizant's PERM labour certification filings, raising visa scrutiny concerns.

all_candidates.topic: Should Gram Sabhas have explicit veto power on forest land diversion?
all_candidates.news_anchor: The Ministry of Tribal Affairs stated on September 7, 2026, that there is no provision for obtaining Gram Sabha consent for forest clearance projects under the Forest Rights Act.

all_candidates.topic: Is government support crucial for India's zero-emission freight transition?
all_candidates.news_anchor: NITI Aayog launched PACT (Platform for Aggregating Clean Transport) on September 7, 2026, to accelerate zero-emission truck deployment.

all_candidates.topic: Will new broadcasting ownership rules benefit Indian media?
all_candidates.news_anchor: India has proposed Telecommunications (Television, Radio and Associated Services) Rules 2026, released September 3, 2026, affecting broadcasting foreign investment and ownership.

all_candidates.topic: Should nomination be mandatory for all new demat accounts?
all_candidates.news_anchor: SEBI's revised nomination framework mandates either a nomination or a signed opt-out declaration for new demat accounts and mutual fund folios opened from September 1, 2026.

all_candidates.topic: Should major policy meetings be postponed for international summits?
all_candidates.news_anchor: The 57th GST Council meeting, originally scheduled earlier, was rescheduled to October 7, 2026, due to the BRICS summit, reported September 7, 2026.

all_candidates.topic: Is pausing e-Way Bill enhancements beneficial for businesses?
all_candidates.news_anchor: GSTN kept proposed e-Way Bill enhancements (including mandatory 'Ship to GSTIN') on hold from August 1, 2026, until further notice, reported September 2, 2026.
